evidence.quote:
A generally well written article. Some prior literature dealing with the temporal stability of the type D construct is missing (some of the articles only reporting rank-order stability):

Pedersen, S. S., Yagensky, A., Smith, O. R. F., Yagenska, O., Shpak, V., & Denollet, J. (2009). Preliminary evidence for the cross-cultural utility of the type D personality construct in the Ukraine. International Journal of Behavioral Medicine, 16(2), 108–115. [external resource identifier omitted]
This study did not include enough information on temporal stability to warrant its inclusion in the current paper. It focuses mainly on structural validity.
